title: Partition Array Into K-Distinct Groups
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, decide if it's feasible to divide all elements of nums into one or more groups, where each group contains exactly k distinct elements, with each element in nums belonging to exactly one group.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, decide if it's feasible to divide all elements of nums into one or more groups, where each group contains exactly k distinct elements, with each element in nums belonging to exactly one group. Return true if possible, otherwise false.
constraints: Every group has exactly k pairwise-distinct elements.
All occurrences must be used exactly once.
reference_solution:
def can_partition_distinct_groups(nums,k):
    from collections import Counter
    groups,remainder=divmod(len(nums),k)
    if remainder:return False
    return max(Counter(nums).values())<=groups
